violations.text: Meat pies, chourice pies and spinach pies from an unapproved source were observed in establishment. Foods were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Approved Food Source guidance document provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Potato chips packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including sub ingredients), the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Other grab and go items were also missing sub ingredients. PIC informed and food labelling guidance document provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of soil residue. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The ceiling vents in the kitchen area area have an accumulation of soil residue and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
Pickles and pickled red onions (in deli containers) were observed held for more than 7 days. Foods were voluntarily disposed of in compost. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2025

Jarred pickles were observed on shelves for retail sale. Owner voluntarily removed product from public sale. All product removed from premises. Establishment must submit a HACCP plan and receive approval from RIDOH CFP for jarred pickles. PIC stated practice will be ceased. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2025

Jarred pickles were observed on shelves for retail sale. Owner voluntarily removed product from public sale. All product removed from premises. Establishment must submit a HACCP plan for jarred pickles. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Soups packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including sub ingredients), the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of white residue. New Violation. Correct By: 10/25/2024
Opening observed in restroom wall; coving incomplete. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2024
